description.value: Dragon Bowl is a modern Chinese restaurant chain founded in 2022, with a Burnaby outpost on Kingsway specializing in rice bowls, noodle dishes, and bento-style meals made with natural, seasonal ingredients. The restaurant blends traditional Chinese flavours with a health-focused approach, including vegetarian choices and customizable meal combinations. Online ordering and corporate catering round out an offering aimed at quick, satisfying meals.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Burnaby location at 4929 Kingsway with phone 604-564-4854 (not present in OSM tags). Takeout and online ordering are explicitly offered; the about page mentions 'refreshing vegetarian options,' confirming at least vegetarian menu items. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, or washroom availability, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website provides 604-564-4854 for the Burnaby location — should be added to OSM.
Website mentions four locations (Downtown Vancouver, New Westminster, Burnaby, Richmond) but OSM record covers only the Burnaby node; ensure no duplicate OSM records exist for the same chain.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Burnaby location is an active, legitimate restaurant on Kingsway suitable for touring cyclists seeking a quick meal, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. On-site review or direct contact is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website lists a New Westminster location in the /about/ page text but does not give a street address for it; only three addresses appear in the contact form (Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond). Worth confirming whether a New Westminster location is open.
